Experimental Phase 3 R methods: advanced transfer diagnostics

etr-advanced-transfer-diagnostics.Rd

Native R scientific methods and diagnostics under active qualification; these functions are not cleared for a CRAN release or calibrated inference.

Usage

etr_discretize_states(
  x,
  bins = 3L,
  method = c("quantile", "equal_width")
)

etr_effective_transfer_entropy(
  source,
  target,
  k_target = 1L,
  k_source = 1L,
  lag = 1L,
  conditioning = NULL,
  n_shuffles = 99L,
  seed = 1L
)

etr_simulate_te_null(
  n = 400L,
  persistence = 0.80,
  seed = 42L
)

etr_evaluate_te_null(
  simulations = 20L,
  n = 400L,
  persistence = .8,
  n_surrogates = 39L,
  seed = 100L,
  nominal = .05
)

Arguments

x

A native trajectory object, sparse collection, numeric sequence, or validated diagnostic according to the function.

bins

Number of support bins or discrete-state bins, according to the function.

method

Declared estimation, binning, or smoothing method.

source

Discrete source sequence.

target

Discrete target sequence.

k_target

Target autoregressive history order.

k_source

Source history order.

lag

Source-to-response time lag in discrete samples.

conditioning

Optional aligned discrete conditioning states.

n_shuffles

Number of permuted-source TE bias-reference replicates.

seed

Deterministic random seed.

n

Number of time-series observations.

persistence

Within-process Markov state persistence probability.

simulations

Independent known-truth Monte Carlo dataset count.

n_surrogates

Number of circular-source-shift surrogate replicates.

nominal

Diagnostic flagging threshold, not a validated type-I error probability.

Details

These methods have explicitly limited scientific scope. Sparse estimation uses fdapace when requested; functional mixed models use optional refund. Marginal sparse fits do not estimate joint cross-channel covariance. Cluster bootstrap resamples participants, not trials. Transfer entropy describes discrete predictive information, not causality, and its diagnostic p-values are not generally calibrated. See docs/phase3-expansion-methods.md for independent simulation contracts.

Value

A typed native model, diagnostic, Monte Carlo audit, or base R plot; returned components are documented in the Phase 3 methods article.
